# Protection Warrior — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 13/5/33 — respec at level 30. The decision loop walks 69 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (8 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/protection/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **OK** — 54% of the human spec median (137 vs 252.5 boss DPS over 70 boss fights); tank; 0% hit / 0% crit and GCDs on Shield Block/Taunt [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [protection.md](./protection.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **75 — Concussion Blow** (`P12a-concussion-blow-threat`) — level 42+ · intent `filler` · spell 12809
  - **When:** in melee range; Concussion Blow is off cooldown; the target is not immune to stun.
  - **Why:** Concussion Blow again, this time on cooldown rather than as the interrupt P07 keeps it for.
  - Sources: [protection-tank.yaml (L543-555)](../../../structured/classes/warrior/protection-tank.yaml#L543-L555); [protection-tank.yaml (L861-870)](../../../structured/classes/warrior/protection-tank.yaml#L861-L870); [leveling.md § Levels 40–49 (L173-198)](leveling.md#levels-40-49); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/protection/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `DBC Talent.dbc:92`; `DBC TalentTab.dbc:163`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L10047`; +4 more].
- **78 — Shield Slam** (`P09-shield-slam`) — level 30+ · intent `filler` · spell 23922
  - **When:** a shield is equipped; in melee range; Shield Slam is off cooldown; at least 20 rage.
  - **Why:** Protection talent at 30.
  - Sources: [protection.md § How to play (L33)](protection.md#how-to-play); [protection.md § Revenge/Reprisal deep prot (fresh 60, dungeons) (L153)](protection.md#revengereprisal-deep-prot-fresh-60-dungeons); [protection.md § Threat mechanics (L170)](protection.md#threat-mechanics); [protection.md § DefTac (bot-ready) (L204)](protection.md#deftac-bot-ready); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/protection/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `DBC Talent.dbc:87`; `DBC TalentTab.dbc:163`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L18608`; +5 more].
- **80 — Revenge** (`P08-revenge`) — level 14+ · intent `filler` · spell 6572
  - **When:** in melee range; the resident has the block/dodge/parry state; Revenge is off cooldown; at least 5 rage.
  - **Why:** Usable only after a block/dodge/parry: spell_template.casterAuraState 1 = AURA_STATE_DEFENSE (SpellDefines.h L533); v2 aura_state(1) reads that state, so the push is no longer refused by the core.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/protection/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql 20260508064255_world.sql L4873`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L5594`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L5593`; +3 more].
- **170 — Heroic Strike** (`P17-heroic-strike`) — level 1+ · intent `filler` · spell 78
  - **When:** in melee range; at least 50 rage.
  - **Why:** On-next-swing rage dump on single targets (attributes 327700, bit 0x4, no start-recovery), so it spends a swing and not a global.
  - Sources: [protection.md § How to play (L32-33)](protection.md#how-to-play); [protection-tank.yaml (L556-558)](../../../structured/classes/warrior/protection-tank.yaml#L556-L558); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warrior/protection/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_playercreateinfo_spell.sql L41`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L251`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; +2 more].
- **180 — Rend** (`P18-rend`) — level 4+ · intent `filler` · spell 772
  - **When:** in melee range; the target does not have Rend; target health above 50%; the target lives at least 15 s; at least 26 rage.
  - **Why:** Bleed on targets that will live; castable in Battle and Defensive Stance.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **P00u-free-action-rattlegore — Use Free Action Potion:** Rattlegore (11622) stuns; the Scholomance guide: pop a Free Action Potion 5-10 s into the fight so his stun misses (aura 6615, mechanic 11 immunity).
- **P00u-mighty-rage — Use Mighty Rage Potion:** The arms and fury files already carry it on a boss (A00u-mighty-rage).
- **P19s-battle-stance-for-charge — Battle Stance:** Gates are the payload's own (P19: 8-25 yd, Charge ready, out of combat) plus aura_self(71), and only on a LONE creature the party decided to pull: the party tank shoots a pack and charges only a lone creature (PartyRules.h DirectPull, kLoneYards 30: no other hostile within 30 yd), so `enemies_within(30) <= 1`, not a boss or a boss pull, and `party.pull_imminent` (the tank decided a pull within 10 s, Party.cpp; a tank in a level run always has a party). self.since_cast_ms(2457) >= 6000 bounds a dance whose payload fails (the dance can repeat, p1-loop 056 P1L56-C2). Rage: a stance change sets rage to what Tactical Mastery keeps (0 without it, `core SpellAuras.cpp L2447-L2483`), so the swap costs nothing out of combat and Charge's own rage is capped at the return swap.
- **P04ms-battle-stance-for-mocking-blow — Battle Stance:** TACTICAL MASTERY IS REQUIRED: a stance change sets rage to what the talent keeps, 5/10/15/20/25 for ranks 1-5 (`core SpellAuras.cpp L2447-L2483`; talent spells 12295, 12676-12679 are separate aura ids, no spell_chain rows: `doc research/db-queries/tkbplay-266.result.txt`) and Mocking Blow costs 10, so the gate is rank 2 or more, read from the passive auras the resident carries (auras_self lists passives, checked on a live TICK). DANCE (HO-P1-LOOP-056, code 63355d3d8: a rule that casts another stance holds the declared-stance block until the next non-shifting cast, at most formHoldDecisions): this rule takes Battle Stance, the payload rule outranks every rule castable in Battle Stance, the loop puts Defensive Stance back after the payload.
- **P05-shield-bash-t1 — Shield Bash:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **P05-shield-bash-t2 — Shield Bash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of P05-shield-bash, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **P05-shield-bash-t3 — Shield Bash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of P05-shield-bash, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **P05-shield-bash — Shield Bash:** Interrupt; needs a shield. A bot only interrupted the mob it had selected, so with the party on another mob nobody stopped the heal or the cast (Jammal'an's Healing Wave, the Hateforge cleric's Greater Heal).
- **P06-concussion-blow — Concussion Blow:** Stun as a second interrupt.
- **P06b-disarm-boss — Disarm:** HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (orchestrator ruling, p1-loop v38): the guide's defensive for a tank at 18: "Disarm a hard-hitting melee boss (18, Defensive Stance)". Disarm 676 needs Defensive Stance (stances 131072 = form 18, aura 71), 20 rage (manaCost 200), 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, so it is a boss rule: target.boss, in melee, not a Beast (no weapon to take), and not on a boss whose mask carries the disarm mechanic (target.mechanic_immune(3)).
- **P07-bloodrage — Bloodrage:** Effect 1 energizes 100 tenths = 10 rage at once with no GCD (startRecoveryTime 0), effect 2 triggers 29131 (1 rage per second for 10 s, SpellDuration 1; its INTERRUPT_REGEN effect flags the warrior in combat and stops the out-of-combat rage decay), effect 3 is 10 school damage on self (measured 4.6-5.6% of max health on the streams). P07 (priority 70) outranks P21 (210); eight of the nine ticks were a stunned tank (Smite Stomp, aura 6432) whose casts the runtime refuses for every rule (`cast_refused caster_not_in_control`, Tick.cpp) so the walk fell to P21, and the ninth has a true P07, no refusal and a later rule chosen, which in Loop.cpp is the persona deviation (deviationShare), and Tick.cpp Request stamps a deviation on a cast PUSH only, never on an approach.
- **P12a-concussion-blow-threat — Concussion Blow:** Concussion Blow again, this time on cooldown rather than as the interrupt P07 keeps it for.
- **P09-shield-slam — Shield Slam:** Revenge costs 5 and needs the block/dodge/parry window (aura state 1), Shield Slam 20 and a shield (tkbplay-235.result.txt), so with both ready and 20 rage the order now spends the larger threat first; with under 20 rage Revenge still fires on its own.
- **P08-revenge — Revenge:** Usable only after a block/dodge/parry: spell_template.casterAuraState 1 = AURA_STATE_DEFENSE (SpellDefines.h L533); v2 aura_state(1) reads that state, so the push is no longer refused by the core.
- **P10-shield-block — Shield Block:** Keep it rolling while anything is in melee: recoveryTime 5000 and durationIndex 28 (5 s) are the same number, so cooldown_ready is the refresh gate and no aura test is needed. Reserving Sunder's cost is a real trade, not a free one, and the note states it: at the measured income of about 1.9 rage per second (5.1 rage per landed hit at the fixture's 2.7 s weapon delay) a level 16-19 tank can afford one 10-rage ability about every 5.3 s, which is also Shield Block's cooldown, so P10 and P16-sunder-stack are competing for the whole budget and the priority order decides which of them starves.
- **P12-demoralizing-shout — Demoralizing Shout:** HO-TKB-PLAY-066 (round 87, party B and C): Demoralizing Roar and Demoralizing Shout apply the same aura (MOD_ATTACK_POWER, aura 99) with different values (Roar rank 1 -31, Shout rank 1 -36, Roar 2 -51, Shout 2 -56), so the weaker is refused while the stronger is on the target and the guard `not aura_target(99)` (or 1160) stays true: the feral DPS druid cast Roar 68 times (10 rage each, 680 rage) under a warrior's Shout, every cast landing and no aura 99 ever appearing. The guard is now any Demoralizing aura of either spell (Roar 99, 1735, 9490; Shout 1160, 6190, 11554), on every Roar and Shout rule.
- **P15-cleave — Cleave:** The gate is unchanged and is the Heroic Strike gate's twin: two or more mobs engaged within 5 yd (Cleave 845 to 20569 is range 5 yd, 20 rage, hits the target and the nearest enemy next to it, on the next swing: tkbplay-381.result.txt) and 50 rage, so on one mob (a boss alone included) Heroic Strike (P17, 170) is the dump.
- **P08a-thunder-clap-pack — Thunder Clap:** HO-TKB-PLAY-012 (OQ-1637): the rage gate is 16, the cost at the level-23 build (decision 63, OQ-3115): Improved Thunder Clap 3 (12666) is a SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_COST of -40 in tenths (effectBasePoints -41, dieSides 1) whose class mask 128 is Thunder Clap's spellFamilyFlags, and Spell.cpp applies SPELLMOD_COST to the power cost, so 200 tenths become 160. HO-TKB-PLAY-381 (cast-mix investigation, amp-2 castmix-gap round 154: humans cast Thunder Clap 8.3 per minute, bots 0.45): `not aura_target(6343)` REMOVED from the pack rule.
- **P11t-sunder-other — Sunder Armor:** The view carries aura_target, in_melee_range and hostile; a sheeped mob attacks nobody and is no other_engaged, and the sheep ranks are excluded all the same because CastRefusal refuses a cast at a held mob.
- **P14-battle-shout — Battle Shout:** Why: round 154, Scholomance (Velvor, prot warrior): the party carried Battle Shout in 25-31 per cent of ticks, P14 was true in 41 of 2,210 evaluations (rage under 26) and was pushed 5 times in 18 minutes; the aura id on the warrior is 6673 for the whole run, so aura_self(6673) sees the buff.
- **P16-sunder-stack — Sunder Armor:** Stacks Sunder Armor to spell_template.stackAmount 5 (v2 aura_target_stacks) and stops; the refresh before expiry needs an aura-remaining-time predicate (OQ-1402, proposal in OQ-1409). HO-TKB-PLAY-063 (orchestrator, from the guide): stacking Sunder to five is for an elite or a boss, or for the last mob standing; in a pack the rage goes to a Sunder on every mob (P11t) and to Thunder Clap.
- **P12b-demoralizing-shout-spare — Demoralizing Shout:** HO-TKB-PLAY-066 (round 87, party B and C): Demoralizing Roar and Demoralizing Shout apply the same aura (MOD_ATTACK_POWER, aura 99) with different values (Roar rank 1 -31, Shout rank 1 -36, Roar 2 -51, Shout 2 -56), so the weaker is refused while the stronger is on the target and the guard `not aura_target(99)` (or 1160) stays true: the feral DPS druid cast Roar 68 times (10 rage each, 680 rage) under a warrior's Shout, every cast landing and no aura 99 ever appearing. The guard is now any Demoralizing aura of either spell (Roar 99, 1735, 9490; Shout 1160, 6190, 11554), on every Roar and Shout rule.
- **P13-thunder-clap — Thunder Clap:** OQ-2507 (2026-09-10, p1-loop): the archive puts Thunder Clap in the single-target list too, "once per pull for the attack-speed debuff; usable in Defensive Stance", and the pin backs that on one target as much as on a pack - ten percent off the target's attack speed for 20 rage, and not aura_target(6343) already stops it repeating - so the gate relaxed from enemies_within(8) >= 2 to >= 1; the affected module/bots/decision/test/fixtures snapshots were re-expected in the same change. HO-TKB-PLAY-012 (OQ-1637): the rage gate is 16, the cost at the level-23 build (decision 63, OQ-3115): Improved Thunder Clap 3 (12666) is a SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_COST of -40 in tenths (effectBasePoints -41, dieSides 1) whose class mask 128 is Thunder Clap's spellFamilyFlags, and Spell.cpp applies SPELLMOD_COST to the power cost, so 200 tenths become 160.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **P00u-gurubashi-gumbo:** "Hardened Mushroom + Gurubashi Gumbo (they stack) on mitigation fights" (warrior/protection.md L282): the Hardened Mushroom (51717, level 55) is a drop with no obtainable path here (open question), the Gumbo is the part a tank can carry; it is used out of combat whenever the tank is not Well Fed (a mitigation fight is every tank fight in a level run).
- **P24-intervene-attacked-member:** PROXY: the guide says the healer and the selector is role-blind; a member under 50 percent with a mob on it is the case the guide means, and the 50 is a chosen threshold, not a sourced number (OPEN QUESTION in the handoff: a healer-first selector, or a term for the healer being attacked).
- **P15-cleave:** The guide gives Cleave no rage threshold (only "Cleave when rage is high", leveling.md L138), so 50 is the Heroic Strike band's (protection.md L32); a Cleave pushed on every auto would need a swing-queue term (open question 1).
